blocks.text: AI-native CRM that adapts to how your team actually works

Attio represents the next generation of CRM design. Instead of forcing your data into pre-defined structures, Attio lets you build custom objects, relationships, and workflows that match how your business actually operates. It is like having a relational database with a beautiful interface designed for sales teams.

The AI capabilities are woven throughout the platform. Automatic data enrichment fills in company and contact details. AI suggests next actions based on deal patterns. And smart lists surface opportunities based on criteria that update in real-time.

For startups that find traditional CRMs too rigid, Attio's flexibility is liberating. Track deals, manage partnerships, coordinate fundraising, or manage investor relations - all in the same CRM with custom data models for each use case.
Custom objects, attributes, and relationships for any workflow
Automatic data enrichment for contacts and companies
Multiplayer CRM with live editing and activity feeds
Dynamic segments that update automatically based on criteria
Two-way email sync with automatic contact matching
Full API access for building custom integrations and workflows
Attio is the CRM we recommend for startups that have outgrown spreadsheets but find HubSpot and Salesforce too rigid. Its flexible data model adapts to your business rather than the other way around.
Our team can integrate Attio into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
